name: webcasata-theme
description: Build scripts for the Webcasata WordPress theme.

scripts.build: npm run build:theme && npm run build:woo && npm run build:min
scripts.build:min: sass --style=compressed --no-source-map assets/css/theme.scss assets/css/theme.min.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map assets/css/woocommerce.scss assets/css/woocommerce.min.css
